architecture_summary: Evaluated 11 microservices and 24 inter-service call paths. Frontend proxies traffic into core domain services: cart, catalog, and checkout. Primary systemic risk identified in single-point-of-failure cascade between frontend and stateful services.

experiments.name: Cart Service Total Outage Simulation
experiments.hypothesis: Pausing cart will trigger 500 errors in user add-to-cart operations unless fallback in-memory or degraded cart mode exists.
experiments.rationale: Cart is directly downstream of frontend proxy; high caller volume makes it critical for shopping workflow.

experiments.name: Product Catalog CPU Starvation & Lock Contention
experiments.hypothesis: Throttling CPU to 10% on catalog service will cause p95 latency spikes on homepage rendering; connection pool exhaustion may occur.
experiments.rationale: Product catalog serves all product detail queries. Slowness directly degrades storefront p95 latency.

experiments.name: Recommendation Engine Degradation & Netem Delay
experiments.hypothesis: Recommendation slowness should be masked gracefully by timeout or empty recommendation fallback without impacting purchase checkout.
experiments.rationale: Non-critical dependency; tests whether circuit breaker or graceful degradation pattern is correctly implemented.
